skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe key concepts such as language, speech; content of origin theories, development, nature, function of language, phonetics, vocabulary, semantics, and grammar.
Provide examples from real-life linguistic phenomena to illustrate language theories. Compare different language theories. Classify linguistic phenomena based on predefined criteria.
Apply general theoretical issues about language to explain specific linguistic phenomena.
Express and explain language-related issues confidently.
Independently create, present research, lectures, and work related to language issues creatively, proactively, and thoroughly.
Actively accept knowledge about language and be willing to participate in projects, work related to language such as research, teaching, guiding others.
Propose, trust, and have the ability to defend and take responsibility for practical work applying language theories to solve problems.
